NSNs: 8415-01-595-5396, 8415-01-595-6374, 8415-01-595-5425, and 8415-01-595-6376

Drawings are not available. This will be solicited using FAR Subpart 13.5 procedures. This is an indefinite delivery indefinite quantity procurement. FOB Destination, and Acceptance/Inspection Destination applies. The requested delivery is 45 days. The solicitation will become available on DIBBS after the solicitation issue date. The estimated issue date is 05/2026. Price and Past Performance are evaluation factors. All responsible sources can submit an offer which will be considered.
